name: Mississippi

jury_list.holder: County jury commission; the master list is the county voter registration list (Miss. Code 13-5-8).

sources.cite: Miss. Code 13-5-32 (names drawn from the jury box are public unless the court orders otherwise)
Miss. Code 13-5-8 (master list is the voter registration list)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person may get copies of voter registration files under the Public Records Act, at cost, without SSN, phone, email, date of birth, or age (Miss. Code 23-15-165(6)).

private_challenge.who: Any elector of the county (Miss. Code 23-15-63).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Miss. Code 23-15-63: appeal to the county election commissioners from the registrar's decision allowing a person to register; the appellant must serve written notice of the grounds on the registrant through the sheriff or a constable. Appeals are heard at the September meeting before a general election (23-15-65) and other set meetings (23-15-67).
private_challenge.deadlines: Not stated in 23-15-63. Hearings occur at commission meetings (23-15-65, 23-15-67).
private_challenge.evidence_standard: Written notice stating the grounds (23-15-63). No higher standard stated.

sources.cite: Miss. Code 23-15-65 (commissioners hear appeals; correct illegal registrations)
Miss. Code 23-15-17 (any person with reasonable cause may report a suspected false registration to law enforcement)

county_board.name: Mississippi Secretary of State - county election information
county_board.note: Appeals under 23-15-63 go to the county election commission.

state_election_office.name: Mississippi Secretary of State - Elections and Voting

gates.basis: Jury disqualification records: status unknown (null), so counts only. A county elector may appeal a registration to the election commissioners (23-15-63). Strict gates.

notes: The jury master list is the county voter list itself (13-5-8), so jury records add little beyond the voter roll.
The state compares new registrations with driver's license data and SAVE (23-15-15).
Source note: the official Mississippi Code is published by a commercial vendor behind scripts; sections were read on Justia (2025 code).
sos.ms.gov blocks plain HTTP clients; pages were checked in a browser.
